{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 接入飞书/Lark bot，扫码即用：流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理与安全网守护（dsh 崩溃后飞书仍可自救）。A scan-to-connect bridge bot connecting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark: streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat","id":"gh:1333496313","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-lark-bot","slug":"PlutoKeating/dsh-lark-bot","topics":["ai-agent","bot","bridge","chatbot","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","feishu","feishu-bot","im-bridge","lark","lark-bot","messaging","qrcode","self-healing","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 接入飞书/Lark bot，扫码即用：流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理与安全网守护（dsh 崩溃后飞书"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"仍可自救）。A scan-to-connect bridge bot connecting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark: streaming car"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ds, workspaces, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-lark-bot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"🌏 English · 🌐 官网wiki dsh-lark-bot.arr2018.dpdns.org"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书 · 扫码 30 秒 · 手机指挥本机 coding agent · 崩溃了飞书也照样回你"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 产品简介"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"让 DeepSeek Harness 成为你飞书里的一员，在手机、群聊、话题里直接指挥本机 coding agent。
